This section explains how the automated tests work. For practical steps and input choices, start with Your first check. Unfamiliar terms are explained in the glossary.

.github/workflows/qase-emails.yml

Bundled source snapshot. Credential-like literals are omitted. Line numbers correspond to the audited repository file; this page is for reading and is not executable test code.

1 name: Run Emails tests (Qase)
2 on:
3     workflow_dispatch:
4         inputs:
5             qase_report:
6                 description: 'Enabled/disabled reporting to Qase'
7                 required: true
8             qase_api_base_url:
9                 description: 'Qase API URL'
10                 required: true
11                 default: 'https://api.qase.io/v1/'
12             qase_project_code:
13                 description: 'Qase project code'
14                 required: true
15                 default: 'OQG'
16             qase_run_id:
17                 description: 'Qase Run ID'
18                 required: true
19             qase_run_complete:
20                 description: 'Qase Run autocomplete'
21                 required: true
22 
23 jobs:
24     run_qase_tests:
25         runs-on: ubuntu-latest
26         permissions:
27             contents: write
28             pull-requests: write
29         env:
30             STAGE_ADMIN_LINK: ${{ secrets.STAGE_ADMIN_LINK }}
31             STAGE_ADMIN_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.STAGE_ADMIN_EMAIL }}
32             BASE_URL: ${{ vars.BASE_URL }}
33             DELETE_USER_URL: ${{ vars.DELETE_USER_URL }}
34             STAGE_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.STAGE_ADMIN_PASSWORD }}
35             BROWSER: chromium
36             DEFAULT_USER_LOGIN: ${{ VARS.DEFAULT_USER_LOGIN }}
37             DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD: ${{ vars.DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD }}
38             QASE_TESTOPS_PROJECT: ${{inputs.qase_project_code }}
39             QASE_TESTOPS_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.qase_run_id }}
40             QASE_TESTOPS_RUN_COMPLETE: true
41             QASE_TESTOPS_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.QASE_TESTOPS_API_TOKEN }}
42             QASE_API_BASE_URL: ${{ inputs.qase_api_base_url }}
43             QASE_MODE: 'testops'
44             QASE_FALLBACK: 'report'
45             QASE_REPORT_DRIVER: 'local'
46             QASE_REPORT_CONNECTION_FORMAT: 'json'
47             QASE_REPORT_CONNECTION_PATH: './build/qase-report'
48             PHRASE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PHRASE_API_TOKEN }}
49             PHRASE_API_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.PHRASE_API_BASE_URL }}
50             PHRASE_OQG_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.PHRASE_OQG_PROJECT_ID }}
51             MAILTRAP_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.MAILTRAP_BASE_URL }}
52             MAILTRAP_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.MAILTRAP_API_KEY }}
53             MAILTRAP_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.MAILTRAP_ACCOUNT_ID }}
54             MAILTRAP_INBOX_ID: ${{ secrets.MAILTRAP_INBOX_ID }}
55             QASE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.QASE_API_TOKEN }}
56 
57         steps:
58             - uses: cskmnrpt/qase-link-run@v2
59               env:
60                   QASE_TESTOPS_API_TOKEN: ${{ env.QASE_TESTOPS_API_TOKEN }}
61 
62             - uses: actions/checkout@v4
63 
64             - name: Set up Node.js
65               uses: actions/setup-node@v5
66               with:
67                   node-version: lts/*
68                   cache: 'npm'
69 
70             - name: Install dependencies
71               run: npm ci
72 
73             - name: Install Playwright browsers
74               run: npx playwright install --with-deps
75 
76             - name: Run tests
77               run: npx playwright test tests/emails --workers=2
78
